subject: Vendor intake — procurement & security kickoff scheduling (ACME)
messages:
From: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@acme-corp.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acme-corp.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -0500
Subject: Intro + kickoff for procurement / security review

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the product overview last week — the ACME security and procurement teams want to schedule a formal vendor intake call next week to go through our standard checklist (SOC2 evidence, data residency, contract terms, and SSO integrations). Our suggested attendees are Samir Gupta (cloud engineering), Procurement, and a manager from Security.

Can you propose 2–3 60-minute slots (US Eastern) next week? We'd like the SE on the call to cover technical implications.

Attached: ACME intake form (for your pre-read).

Best,
Elena Martinez
Senior IT Procurement Manager
ACME Corp

Attachment: ACME_intake_form.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 12:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Intro + kickoff for procurement / security review

Elena — thanks for the note and the intake form. Happy to run the kickoff. Proposed 60-minute slots (US ET):

• Tue 2026-11-30 10:00–11:00
• Tue 2026-11-30 14:00–15:00
• Wed 2026-12-01 11:00–12:00

Soojin (SE) will cover architecture and SSO; Dev (our integrations engineer) will be available for deeper technical follow-ups.

Pre-reqs we can cover during the call or supply ahead of time:
- SOC 2 evidence scope and most recent report (we can share a redacted copy)
- High-level network/ingress model and VPC peering options
- Data retention and deletion controls

If one of these slots works, I’ll send a calendar invite and a short mutual action plan so procurement can track deliverables.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com)

Attachment: none

From: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@acme-corp.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acme-corp.com>, CloudOps <cloudops@acme-corp.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:20:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Intro + kickoff for procurement / security review

Hannah / Elena — 14:00 on Tue 11/30 works best for engineering and CloudOps. A couple of asks from our side so the call is productive:

1) Can you include a short (10–15 slide) architecture/ops deck showing how you handle KV cache isolation and routing for multi-tenant workloads?
2) We’ll need to see your SSO SAML config examples and whether you support SCIM for provisioning.
3) Please add a line item in the MAP for timeline to supply SOC2 (redacted) and any third-party pen test evidence.

Thanks,
Samir
Senior Cloud Engineer, ACME

Attachment: none

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@acme-corp.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 11:08:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Intro + kickoff for procurement / security review

Samir — thanks, we’ll be ready. Quick notes on the requested artifacts:

• Architecture/ops deck: I’ll prepare a concise 12-slide deck that focuses on multi-tenant routing, KV cache isolation, and fallback behavior when a model variant is unavailable.
• SSO/SCIM: we support SAML 2.0 and SCIM 2.0; Dev will post an example SAML metadata snippet and the SCIM endpoint contract ahead of the meeting.
• SOC 2: I’ll attach the redacted SOC 2 Type II report and a one-page summary.

I’ve also created a short mutual action plan (MAP) template and attached it — it includes owners and target dates so Procurement can sign off.

See attachments: redacted_SOC2_2026.pdf, MAP_acme_v1.xlsx, saml_example.xml

Best,
Soojin Lee
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redacted_SOC2_2026.pdf; MAP_acme_v1.xlsx; saml_example.xml
